newsitem.title: USA: March CME S&P 500 futures fall 15-pt initial limit.
newsitem.headline: March CME S&P 500 futures fall 15-pt initial limit.

text.p: March Standard & Poor's (S&P) 500 futures at the Chicago Mercantile Exchange (CME) fell the initial 15-point price limit.
The contract fell to a low of 799.15, down 15 points, as U.S. Treasury bond futures skidded after release of prepared Humphrey-Hawkins text by Federal Reserve chairman Alan Greenspan.
Trading can occur at or above the 15-point lower limit for 15 minutes or until 1430 CST/2030 GMT.

Trading would halt for two minutes if the primary futures contract were limit-offered at the end of the 15-minute period. Trading then would resume with the next down limit of 30 points in effect, CME rules state. ((DerivativesDesk(312)408-8750/E-mail:derivatives@reuters.com))
